name: thesis-mcwm-matched-response-v59-20261025
collection_policy: Reuse the actual v53 mu14 actor/F saved in both resident v54 checkpoints. The new day starts with this immutable stochastic actor; its private stream is526259. No new warmup or collector optimizer updates. All branches inherit the same issue actor/global/exogenous RNG and causal memory; both arms run concurrently with independent route-reader offsets.
selection: First issue-visible feasible native stop per declared line/window, with F admitting exact0/7.5s and gap>=1.5*max(simulation step,actionStepLength). No Q disagreement or future outcome enters selection. Missing slots and physical aliases remain reported; no truth-driven reselection or padding.
feedback: Each of9 new training pairs atomically replaces2 ordinary slots:267 ordinary+18 paired next-event rows=285. Exclude the source factual outcome. Admit the paired finite300 label only after max(issue+300,both actual next-event clocks)+30. The same paid outcomes support the passive response fit; no extra slots or gradients. Other branch events are diagnostic logs and never enter replay.
data_stream_change: This is a new57x5 packet protocol, not a replay of v53's14+271 continuous stream. Its disjoint paired next-event rows support synchronized M8 one-step training only. No physical-trace training is installed on disconnected rows.
learner_target: Both start from the same50000 initializer, shared memory-level architecture and retained Adam. Use unchanged synchronized M8 one-step .1V+.9SAC backup with the same frozen mu14 target actor/F, live V/alpha/Q,456 updates and isolated extra M8 stream. No new entropy, trace or feature changes.
no_fresh: Use identical new s,a,current memory and packet schedule for actor/V/temperature. Critic outcome slots use complete historical transitions with zero archival memory. The worker reads only the collector's outcome-free covariates file and never reads fresh r,ns,dt,terminal,next-memory or finite300 labels. Four sampler draws and update counts match fresh.
readout: Reuse passive finite300 line constants and the existing single-headway-feature model, fixed ridge1. Fit only new admitted training pairs in packet release order. Predict wait/ride low-minus-high costs; J300=2W+R, raw global weighted passenger-seconds. Also expose1e-4 scaled gain. No entropy, terminal bootstrap or fabricated successor. No new features or hyperparameter selection.
heldout: Three lines x two fixed windows per scenario. Save issue state, current execution memory and actual actions; long-Q workers open these inputs only after all456 updates and freeze. Only final analysis opens heldout physical truth. All suffix and native post-stop training is zero. Old v55/v38/v37 truth never enters new fitting or selection.
primary_research_goal: Under matched initialization, feedback and update budgets, a dripping-data control policy must lower realized passenger cost relative to MC-WM without dripping outcomes. Improvement is judged on the predeclared aggregate; improvement in every line/window is not required.
pilot_gate: This experiment estimates paired300s action-choice cost under a common frozen continuation; it does not establish full-day policy superiority. Report line/lowdim/fresh-Q/no-fresh-Q/fixed0/fixedhigh directions, regret and waiting/ride decomposition. Consider a small control experiment only if a prespecified readout improves aggregate heldout cost versus no_fresh-Q and fixed0 without higher aggregate stable cost, with complete integrity and coverage. Do not select features or tune on heldout truth; no control launch is automatic.
